recipes.title: Chicken Adobo
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food chicken adobo prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Marinate 1kg Chicken: Combine 1kg chicken, 0.5 cup soy sauce, 1 head crushed garlic, 1 tbsp peppercorns, and 4 bay leaves in a bowl for 30 minutes.
Sear Chicken: Heat 3 tbsp oil in skillet, seared 1kg chicken pieces for 8 minutes until golden brown.
Boil 0.5 Cup Vinegar: Pour marinade and 0.5 cup cane vinegar; boil uncovered for 5 minutes over medium heat.
Low Simmer: Cover and simmer over low heat for 25 minutes until chicken is tender.
Portion 4 Bowls: Reduce sauce for 5 minutes and serve over 3 cups rice across 4 bowls (yields 4 servings).

recipes.title: Pork Adobo
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food pork adobo prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Marinate 1kg Pork: Cut 1kg pork belly into cubes, marinate in 0.5 cup soy sauce, 1 head garlic, and 1 tbsp peppercorns for 30 minutes.
Sear & Render Fat: Sear pork belly in skillet for 10 minutes until fat renders and edges brown.
Boil 0.5 Cup Vinegar: Add 0.5 cup cane vinegar and 4 bay leaves; boil uncovered for 5 minutes.
Simmer Tender: Cover and simmer on low heat for 35 minutes until melt-in-your-mouth tender.
Divide 4 Plates: Fry pork in rendered fat for 5 minutes and portion into 4 warm dinner plates (4 servings).

recipes.title: Adobong Sitaw
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food adobong sitaw prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Sauté Pork & Aromatics: Heat 3 tbsp oil; sauté 1kg pork belly with 1 head garlic and 2 onions for 5 minutes.
Stir-Fry 10 Sitaw: Add 10 string beans (cut) and stir-fry over high heat for 3 minutes.
Simmer Sauce: Pour 0.5 cup soy sauce and 0.5 cup cane vinegar, simmering for 5 minutes.
Portion 4 Servings: Divide adobong sitaw into 4 bowls to serve 4 dinner portions.

recipes.title: Adobong Kangkong
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food adobong kangkong prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Sauté 1 Head Garlic: Heat 3 tbsp oil; sauté 1 head crushed garlic for 2 minutes until golden.
Stir-Fry Kangkong: Add 1 bunch kangkong stems first for 2 minutes, then add leaves.
Season Sauce: Pour 0.5 cup soy sauce, 0.5 cup vinegar, and 1 tbsp peppercorns for 3 minutes.
Portion 4 Plates: Serve hot across 4 side dishes to yield 4 portions.

recipes.title: Adobong Pusit
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food adobong pusit prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Prep 500g Squid: Clean 500g squid, reserving black ink sacs.
Sauté Aromatics: Sauté 1 head garlic, 2 onions, and 3 chilies in 3 tbsp oil for 4 minutes.
Simmer Ink Sauce: Add squid, ink, 0.5 cup soy sauce, and 0.5 cup vinegar; simmer 10 minutes.
Portion 4 Bowls: Serve squid in black ink sauce into 4 bowls for 4 dinner servings.

recipes.title: Sinigang na Baboy
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food sinigang na baboy prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Boil 1kg Pork Ribs: Boil 1kg pork ribs with 2 onions in 6 cups water for 40 minutes.
Sour Broth: Add 1 pack tamarind mix and 3 tbsp fish sauce; boil 5 minutes.
Cook Veggies: Add 2 eggplants and 10 sitaw string beans; simmer for 5 minutes.
Steam Greens: Add 1 bunch kangkong and 3 chilies, cover and steam 3 minutes.
Portion 4 Soup Bowls: Ladle rich sour pork soup into 4 large soup bowls (4 servings).

recipes.title: Sinigang na Hipon
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food sinigang na hipon prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Boil Sour Base: Boil 2 onions and 1 pack tamarind mix in 5 cups water for 5 minutes.
Cook 500g Shrimp: Add 500g fresh shrimp and 3 chilies; boil for 5 minutes until pink.
Steam Kangkong: Add 1 bunch kangkong leaves, turn off heat, and steam 2 minutes.
Portion 4 Servings: Divide shrimp soup into 4 bowls to serve 4 lunch portions.

recipes.title: Sinigang na Baboy at Hipon
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food sinigang na baboy at hipon prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Boil 1kg Pork Ribs: Boil 1kg pork ribs with 2 onions in 6 cups water for 35 minutes until tender.
Sour Broth & Veggies: Add 1 pack tamarind mix, 3 tbsp fish sauce, 2 eggplants, and 10 sitaw; simmer for 5 minutes.
Add 500g Shrimp: Add 500g fresh whole shrimp and 3 green chilies; boil for 4 minutes until shrimp turn bright pink.
Steam Kangkong: Add 1 bunch fresh kangkong leaves, cover pot, and steam off heat for 2 minutes.
Portion 4 Combo Bowls: Ladle rich pork and shrimp sinigang into 4 large soup bowls (yields 4 generous servings).

recipes.title: Sinigang na Bangus
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food sinigang na bangus prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Boil Tamarind Stock: Boil 2 onions, 3 tbsp fish sauce, and 1 pack tamarind mix in 5 cups water.
Cook 2 Bangus Fish: Add 2 milkfish (bangus cut into 4 belly portions); simmer 8 minutes.
Add Greens: Add 3 chilies and 1 bunch kangkong; simmer 3 minutes.
Portion 4 Dishes: Serve 1 bangus portion per bowl across 4 soup bowls.

recipes.title: Sinigang na Baka
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food sinigang na baka prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Slow Simmer 1kg Beef: Boil 1kg beef brisket with 2 onions in 6 cups water for 60 minutes.
Sour Broth & Veggies: Add 1 pack tamarind mix, 10 sitaw, and 2 eggplants; simmer 8 minutes.
Season Patis: Add 3 tbsp fish sauce and 3 chilies; simmer 3 minutes.
Portion 4 Bowls: Divide tender beef broth into 4 large bowls to serve 4.

recipes.title: Beef Bulalo
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food beef bulalo prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Parboil 1.5kg Shank: Boil 1.5kg beef shank for 10 minutes, drain and rinse marrow bone.
Slow Simmer Marrow: Simmer beef shank with 2 onions and 1 tbsp peppercorns for 120 minutes until tender.
Add Root Veggies: Add 2 potatoes and 2 carrots; simmer covered for 15 minutes.
Season Broth: Add 3 tbsp fish sauce and simmer for 5 minutes.
Portion 4 Plates: Divide beef marrow shank and vegetables into 4 large serving bowls (4 servings).

recipes.title: Kare-Kare
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food kare-kare prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Simmer 1kg Beef: Boil 1kg beef brisket for 60 minutes, reserving 3 cups broth.
Whisk Peanut Sauce: Whisk 0.5 cup peanut butter and 2 tbsp annatto into warm broth for 3 minutes.
Thicken Gravy: Sauté 1 head garlic and 2 onions, add peanut broth, simmer 10 minutes.
Add Veggies: Fold 2 eggplants and 10 sitaw; simmer for 5 minutes.
Portion 4 Plates: Serve with 3 tbsp bagoong shrimp paste across 4 dinner plates.

recipes.title: Crispy Lechon Kawali
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food crispy lechon kawali prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Boil 1kg Pork Belly: Boil 1kg pork belly with 1 head garlic, 4 bay leaves, and 1 tbsp peppercorns for 45 minutes.
Air Dry Skin: Dry pork belly in refrigerator for 60 minutes.
Deep Fry Crackling: Deep fry 1kg pork belly in 3 tbsp oil for 15 minutes until skin crackles.
Slice Cubes: Chop into bite-sized crispy pork cubes.
Portion 4 Plates: Divide crispy lechon kawali into 4 serving plates (4 servings).

recipes.title: Sizzling Pork Sisig
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food sizzling pork sisig prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Boil & Charcoal Grill: Boil 1kg pork belly for 20 minutes, then grill for 15 minutes.
Dice 1/4-Inch: Dice grilled pork belly into fine 1/4-inch cubes.
Sauté Aromatics: Sauté 2 onions, 4 red chilies, 4 calamansi, and 0.5 cup soy sauce for 8 minutes.
Sizzling Plate: Heat plate, melt butter, add sisig, and crack 2 eggs on top.
Portion 4 Plates: Serve sizzling sisig split into 4 portions.

recipes.title: Tinolang Manok
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food tinolang manok prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Sauté Ginger Base: Sauté 1 thumb ginger, 1 head garlic, and 2 onions in 3 tbsp oil for 4 minutes.
Sear 1kg Chicken: Add 1kg chicken and 3 tbsp fish sauce, searing for 6 minutes.
Simmer Papaya Broth: Add 5 cups water and 1 green papaya; simmer for 25 minutes.
Portion 4 Bowls: Ladle chicken ginger soup into 4 bowls for 4 lunch servings.

recipes.title: Beef Kaldereta
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food beef kaldereta prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Sear 1kg Beef: Sear 1kg beef brisket in 3 tbsp oil for 8 minutes until browned.
Simmer Sauce: Add 1 cup tomato sauce, 0.5 cup liver spread, and broth; simmer for 60 minutes.
Add Veggies: Add 2 potatoes, 2 carrots, 1 bell pepper, and 3 chilies; simmer 10 minutes.
Portion 4 Servings: Scoop beef kaldereta into 4 dinner plates.

recipes.title: Chicken Afritada
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food chicken afritada prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Sauté 1kg Chicken: Sauté 2 onions and 1kg chicken in 3 tbsp oil for 8 minutes.
Simmer Tomato Base: Add 1 cup tomato sauce, 2 potatoes, and 2 carrots; simmer for 20 minutes.
Add Bell Peppers: Add 1 bell pepper and simmer 5 minutes.
Portion 4 Plates: Divide chicken afritada into 4 lunch plates.

recipes.title: Pork Menudo
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food pork menudo prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Dice Match Items: Dice 800g pork shoulder, 2 hotdogs, 2 potatoes, and 2 carrots into cubes.
Stew Pork: Sauté pork shoulder in 1 cup tomato sauce and 0.5 cup soy sauce for 25 minutes.
Add Hotdogs & Veggies: Add hotdogs, potatoes, and carrots; simmer 10 minutes.
Portion 4 Servings: Serve menudo over rice across 4 plates.

recipes.title: Bicol Express
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food bicol express prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Sauté Pork & Bagoong: Sauté 1kg pork belly, 1 head garlic, and 3 tbsp bagoong for 7 minutes.
Add 2 Cups Gata: Pour 2 cups coconut milk; simmer for 20 minutes.
Load Chilies: Add 3 green chilies and 4 red chilies; simmer 8 minutes.
Portion 4 Plates: Serve spicy Bicol Express across 4 dinner plates.

recipes.title: Laing
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food laing prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Simmer 2 Cups Gata: Simmer 2 cups coconut milk with 1 thumb ginger, pork, and bagoong for 10 minutes.
Layer Taro Leaves: Layer taro leaves without stirring; simmer for 20 minutes.
Simmer Creamy: Add 4 red chilies and simmer 10 minutes.
Portion 4 Bowls: Serve creamy laing into 4 dinner bowls.

recipes.title: Pinakbet Tagalog
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food pinakbet tagalog prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Sauté Pork Belly: Sauté 1kg pork belly strips for 7 minutes.
Add Bagoong: Add 3 tbsp bagoong shrimp paste; sauté 3 minutes.
Steam Veggies: Layer 0.5 squash, 10 sitaw, 1 ampalaya, and 2 eggplants; steam 15 minutes.
Portion 4 Servings: Scoop pinakbet into 4 lunch plates.

recipes.title: Ginisang Monggo
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food ginisang monggo prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Boil Mung Beans: Boil mung beans for 30 minutes until soft.
Sauté Pork: Sauté 1kg pork belly with 1 head garlic and 2 onions for 6 minutes.
Combine & Kangkong: Combine beans and pork, add 1 bunch kangkong for 2 minutes.
Portion 4 Bowls: Ladle ginisang monggo into 4 soup bowls.

recipes.title: Tortang Talong
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food tortang talong prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Char 2 Eggplants: Char 2 eggplants over flame for 10 minutes and peel skin.
Flatten & Dip Egg: Flatten eggplants with fork and dip into 2 beaten eggs.
Pan Fry 2 Omelets: Fry in 3 tbsp oil for 4 minutes per side until golden.
Portion 4 Plates: Cut into 4 portions to serve 4 breakfast plates.

recipes.title: Lumpia Shanghai
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food lumpia shanghai prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Mix Meat Filling: Mix 500g ground beef, 2 carrots, 2 onions, and 2 eggs for 3 minutes.
Wrap 20 Lumpia: Wrap filling into 20 lumpia wrappers tightly.
Deep Fry Rolls: Fry in 3 tbsp oil for 6 minutes until crispy golden.
Portion 4 Plates: Divide 20 rolls into 4 plates (5 rolls per serving).

recipes.title: Lumpiang Sariwa
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food lumpiang sariwa prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Sauté Veggies: Sauté 2 carrots and 10 sitaw in 1 head garlic for 8 minutes.
Wrap 4 Rolls: Wrap cooked veggies into 20 lumpia wrappers forming 4 large rolls.
Simmer Peanut Sauce: Simmer 0.5 cup peanut butter for 5 minutes and drizzle over rolls.
Portion 4 Plates: Serve 1 large fresh lumpia per plate for 4 servings.

recipes.title: Pancit Canton
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food pancit canton prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Sauté Meats: Sauté 1kg chicken and 500g shrimp in 1 head garlic for 6 minutes.
Add Broth & Veggies: Add broth, 0.5 cup soy sauce, and 2 carrots; simmer 5 minutes.
Toss 250g Canton: Toss 250g canton noodles into wok for 5 minutes.
Portion 4 Bowls: Serve pancit canton into 4 merienda plates.

recipes.title: Pancit Bihon Guisado
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food pancit bihon guisado prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Soak 250g Bihon: Soak 250g bihon noodles for 10 minutes.
Sauté Pork & Veggies: Sauté 800g pork shoulder and 2 carrots in 0.5 cup soy sauce for 7 minutes.
Toss Bihon: Toss bihon noodles into skillet for 5 minutes; serve with 4 calamansi.
Portion 4 Plates: Divide bihon guisado into 4 merienda servings.

recipes.title: Pancit Palabok
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food pancit palabok prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Boil 250g Noodles: Boil 250g bihon noodles for 8 minutes and drain.
Cook Orange Sauce: Heat 2 tbsp annatto, 500g shrimp stock, and 3 tbsp fish sauce for 10 minutes.
Garnish Platter: Pour orange sauce over noodles, top with 2 eggs and 4 calamansi.
Portion 4 Servings: Divide palabok into 4 merienda plates.

recipes.title: Beef Tapsilog
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food beef tapsilog prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Marinate Tapa: Marinate 1kg beef brisket in 0.5 cup soy sauce, 4 calamansi, and 1 head garlic for 30 minutes.
Pan Fry Tapa: Fry beef tapa in 3 tbsp oil for 6 minutes until caramelized.
Fry 3 Cups Rice: Fry 3 cups rice with garlic for 5 minutes.
Fry 2 Eggs: Fry 2 eggs sunny-side up.
Portion 4 Silog Plates: Serve tapa, garlic rice, and egg across 4 breakfast plates.

recipes.title: Pork Tocilog
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food pork tocilog prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Simmer Tocino: Boil 800g pork shoulder tocino with 3 tbsp brown sugar and water for 10 minutes.
Caramelize Tocino: Fry pork in rendered oil for 5 minutes until glazed.
Fry 3 Cups Rice: Fry 3 cups garlic rice for 5 minutes.
Fry 2 Eggs: Fry 2 eggs sunny-side up.
Portion 4 Silog Plates: Serve tocino, garlic rice, and egg across 4 breakfast plates.

recipes.title: Bangsilog
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food bangsilog prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Marinate 2 Bangus: Marinate 2 milkfish in 0.5 cup vinegar and 1 head garlic for 30 minutes.
Deep Fry Fish: Fry milkfish cut into 4 pieces in 3 tbsp oil for 6 minutes per side until crisp.
Fry 3 Cups Rice: Fry 3 cups garlic rice for 5 minutes.
Fry 2 Eggs: Fry 2 eggs sunny-side up.
Portion 4 Silog Plates: Serve bangus, garlic rice, and egg across 4 plates (4 servings).

recipes.title: Chicken Inasal
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food chicken inasal prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Marinate 1kg Chicken: Marinate 1kg chicken in 4 calamansi, 1 thumb ginger, 1 head garlic, and 0.5 cup vinegar for 60 minutes.
Make Annatto Oil: Melt butter with 2 tbsp annatto seeds for 5 minutes.
Grill & Baste: Grill chicken over charcoal for 20 minutes while basting with annatto oil.
Portion 4 Plates: Serve 1kg grilled inasal chicken with 3 cups garlic rice across 4 plates.

recipes.title: Pork Igado
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food pork igado prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Sauté Aromatics: Sauté 1 head garlic and 2 onions in 3 tbsp oil for 4 minutes.
Cook 800g Pork: Add 800g pork shoulder strips; cook for 10 minutes.
Simmer Sauce: Add 1 bell pepper, 0.5 cup soy sauce, and 0.5 cup vinegar; simmer 15 minutes.
Portion 4 Servings: Divide Igado into 4 dinner plates.

recipes.title: Dinuguan (Pork Blood Stew)
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food dinuguan (pork blood stew) prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Sauté 1kg Pork: Sauté 1kg pork belly with 1 head garlic and 2 onions for 8 minutes.
Pour Blood Sauce: Pour pork blood and 0.5 cup vinegar, stirring continuously for 5 minutes.
Simmer 3 Chilies: Add 3 green chilies and 4 bay leaves; simmer for 25 minutes.
Portion 4 Bowls: Serve dark pork dinuguan into 4 stew bowls.

recipes.title: Escabeche na Bangus
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food escabeche na bangus prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Fry 2 Milkfish: Fry 2 whole milkfish (cut into 4 pieces) in 3 tbsp oil for 12 minutes until crisp.
Make Sweet & Sour Sauce: Sauté 1 thumb ginger, 1 bell pepper, 0.5 cup vinegar, and 3 tbsp brown sugar for 6 minutes.
Pour Sauce: Pour sweet sour sauce over fried milkfish.
Portion 4 Plates: Serve 1 fish piece per plate for 4 servings.

recipes.title: Kinilaw na Hipon
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food kinilaw na hipon prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Cure 500g Shrimp: Pour 4 calamansi and 0.5 cup vinegar over 500g raw shrimp for 15 minutes.
Toss Aromatics: Drain liquid, toss with 1 thumb ginger, 2 onions, and 3 chilies for 2 minutes.
Portion 4 Bowls: Serve fresh cured kinilaw chilled in 4 appetizer bowls.

recipes.title: Pork Mechado
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food pork mechado prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Sear 800g Pork: Sear 800g pork shoulder in 3 tbsp oil for 7 minutes.
Simmer Tomato Base: Add 1 cup tomato sauce, 0.5 cup soy sauce, and 4 calamansi; simmer 40 minutes.
Add 2 Potatoes & Carrots: Add 2 potatoes and 2 carrots; simmer 12 minutes.
Portion 4 Plates: Divide pork mechado into 4 dinner plates.

recipes.title: Champorado
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food champorado prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Boil 2 Cups Sticky Rice: Boil 2 cups sticky rice with cocoa powder in 4 cups water for 20 minutes.
Sweeten Porridge: Stir in 3 tbsp brown sugar for 5 minutes until glossy.
Swirl 1 Can Milk: Swirl 1 can evaporated milk and condensed milk over top.
Portion 4 Bowls: Ladle champorado into 4 breakfast bowls.

recipes.title: Arroz Caldo
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food arroz caldo prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Sauté Ginger Base: Sauté 1 thumb ginger, 1 head garlic, 2 onions, and 1kg chicken for 6 minutes.
Simmer 3 Cups Rice: Add 3 cups rice and 5 cups broth; simmer 25 minutes.
Garnish Eggs: Top with 2 hard-boiled eggs (halved into 4) and 4 calamansi.
Portion 4 Bowls: Serve hot arroz caldo into 4 large bowls.

recipes.title: Turon (Banana Lumpia)
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food turon (banana lumpia) prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Roll 4 Bananas: Roll 4 saba bananas in 3 tbsp brown sugar.
Wrap 20 Lumpia: Wrap in 20 lumpia wrappers tightly for 5 minutes.
Caramelize Crisp: Fry in 3 tbsp oil while sprinkling sugar for 6 minutes.
Portion 4 Plates: Divide 20 turon rolls across 4 plates (5 rolls per serving).

recipes.title: Halo-Halo
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food halo-halo prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Layer Preserves: Layer 4 saba bananas and preserves into 4 tall glasses.
Mound Shaved Ice: Fill 4 glasses to the brim with finely shaved ice.
Drizzle 1 Can Milk: Drizzle 1 can evaporated milk and condensed milk over shaved ice.
Portion 4 Glasses: Serve 4 tall halo-halo dessert glasses.

recipes.title: Margherita Pizza
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food margherita pizza prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Dough Prep: Mix 1 cup flour, yeast, and 1/3 cup water; roll into 4 small individual pizza bases.
Assemble Toppings: Spread 1 cup tomato sauce, 200g sliced mozzarella, and fresh basil over bases.
Bake Hot: Bake at 230°C (450°F) for 12 minutes until crust is golden and cheese is bubbly.
Portion 4 Pizzas: Drizzle 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil; serve 4 personal pizza pies.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Carbonara
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food spaghetti carbonara prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Boil Pasta: Boil 400g spaghetti in salted water for 10 minutes until al dente.
Crisp Bacon: Fry 300g chopped bacon in a pan for 6 minutes until crispy.
Emulsify Sauce: Whisk 2 eggs with 100g parmesan cheese and 1 tbsp cracked peppercorns.
Combine & Portion: Toss hot pasta into bacon pan, remove from heat, stir in egg mixture into creamy sauce; divide into 4 pasta bowls.

recipes.title: Fettuccine Alfredo
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food fettuccine alfredo prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Boil Fettuccine: Cook 400g fettuccine pasta for 10 minutes until tender.
Make Cream Base: Melt 50g butter with 1 head minced garlic and 1 cup heavy cream in skillet.
Add Cheese: Stir in 100g parmesan cheese over low heat until velvety smooth.
Portion 4 Plates: Toss cooked fettuccine into Alfredo cream sauce; serve across 4 pasta plates.

recipes.title: Lasagna Bolognese
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food lasagna bolognese prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Cook Bolognese Sauce: Sauté 500g ground beef with 2 chopped onions and 1 cup tomato sauce for 20 minutes.
Layer Lasagna: Layer boiled pasta sheets, meat sauce, 250g ricotta, and 200g mozzarella in a baking dish.
Bake Golden: Bake at 190°C (375°F) for 35 minutes until bubbly and golden brown on top.
Slice 4 Portions: Let rest 10 minutes, then slice into 4 hearty lasagna squares.

recipes.title: Chicken Cacciatore
recipes.description: Authentic Italian Food chicken cacciatore prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Sear Chicken: Season 1kg chicken pieces and sear in 3 tbsp olive oil for 8 minutes until golden.
Sauté Veggies: Add 2 chopped onions, 1 head garlic, and 1 sliced bell pepper; cook 5 minutes.
Simmer Sauce: Pour 1 cup tomato sauce; simmer covered over low heat for 25 minutes.
Portion 4 Servings: Plate rustic hunter-style chicken with vegetables into 4 deep bowls.

recipes.title: Risotto alla Milanese
recipes.description: Authentic Italian Food risotto alla milanese prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Toast Arborio Rice: Melt 50g butter, sauté 2 onions and 3 cups rice for 3 minutes.
Ladle Hot Broth: Gradually add 4 cups warm broth infused with annatto/saffron, stirring constantly for 20 minutes.
Finish Mantecatura: Fold in 100g parmesan cheese until golden and creamy.
Portion 4 Bowls: Serve warm golden risotto into 4 wide risotto bowls.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmigiana
recipes.description: Authentic Italian Food chicken parmigiana prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Bread Cutlets: Dip 1kg flattened chicken breasts into 2 beaten eggs, then coat in 1 cup panko breadcrumbs.
Pan Fry: Fry breaded chicken cutlets in oil for 4 minutes per side until crisp.
Top & Melt: Top each cutlet with 1 cup tomato sauce, 200g mozzarella, and parmesan; bake 10 minutes.
Portion 4 Servings: Serve 1 crispy chicken parmigiana breast per plate for 4 servings.

recipes.title: Tiramisu
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food tiramisu prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Whip Cream & Eggs: Beat 2 egg yolks with 3 tbsp sugar, fold in 1 cup whipped heavy cream.
Soak Biscuits: Dip ladyfinger biscuits quickly into espresso coffee.
Layer Dessert: Layer coffee-soaked biscuits and mascarpone cream in dish.
Chill 4 Portions: Dust with cocoa powder, chill 4 hours, and cut into 4 dessert portions.

recipes.title: Panna Cotta
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food panna cotta prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Heat Cream: Heat 1 cup heavy cream and 1 can condensed milk over low heat with sugar.
Set Gelatin: Stir in dissolved gelatin powder until smooth; do not boil.
Pour Ramekins: Pour warm cream mixture into 4 dessert ramekins.
Portion 4 Servings: Chill 4 hours until set; top with berry coulis for 4 servings.

recipes.title: Frittata di Spaghetti
recipes.description: Authentic Italian Food frittata di spaghetti prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Whisk Batter: Whisk 2 eggs with 100g parmesan cheese in a bowl.
Combine Leftover Pasta: Fold 400g cooked spaghetti into egg mixture.
Fry Skillet: Melt 50g butter in pan, pour spaghetti batter, cook 6 minutes per side like an omelet.
Slice 4 Portions: Slice golden frittata into 4 wedge portions.

recipes.title: Penne alla Arrabbiata
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food penne alla arrabbiata prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Boil Penne: Boil 400g penne pasta for 11 minutes until al dente.
Spicy Tomato Base: Sauté 1 head garlic and 4 crushed red chilies in 3 tbsp olive oil for 2 minutes.
Simmer Arrabbiata: Add 1 cup tomato sauce; simmer 8 minutes.
Portion 4 Bowls: Toss cooked penne into spicy tomato sauce; divide into 4 pasta bowls.

recipes.title: Minestrone Soup
recipes.description: Authentic Italian Food minestrone soup prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Sauté Veggies: Sauté 2 chopped onions, 1 head garlic, 2 carrots, and 2 diced potatoes in 3 tbsp olive oil.
Simmer Broth: Add 3 diced fresh tomatoes and 5 cups water; simmer 15 minutes.
Add Pasta: Add 200g short pasta; cook 10 minutes until veggies and pasta are tender.
Portion 4 Bowls: Ladle vegetable soup into 4 soup bowls (yields 4 healthy servings).

recipes.title: Osso Buco alla Milanese
recipes.description: Authentic Italian Food osso buco alla milanese prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Sear Beef Shanks: Brown 1.5kg beef shanks in 50g butter in a heavy Dutch oven.
Sauté Mirepoix: Remove beef, sauté 2 onions, 2 carrots, and 1 head garlic for 6 minutes.
Braise Low & Slow: Return beef, add 1 cup tomato sauce and 2 cups water; cover and braise for 1 hour until tender.
Portion 4 Plates: Serve braised beef shanks with rich pan sauce across 4 dinner plates.

recipes.title: Caprese Salad
recipes.description: Authentic Italian Food caprese salad prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Slice Tomatoes & Cheese: Thickly slice 3 fresh tomatoes and 200g fresh mozzarella ball.
Arrange Platter: Alternate slices of tomato and mozzarella with 1 bunch fresh basil leaves.
Season & Drizzle: Drizzle 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil and pinch of sea salt.
Portion 4 Plates: Serve fresh Caprese salad across 4 appetizer plates.

recipes.title: Calzone Ripieno
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food calzone ripieno prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Prepare Dough: Divide pizza dough into 4 circles.
Fill Calzone: Fill one half with 4 cooked Italian sausage links, 250g ricotta, and 200g mozzarella.
Fold & Seal: Fold over into half-moons; crimp edges tight to seal inside.
Bake 4 Calzones: Bake at 220°C (425°F) for 18 minutes until golden; serve 4 individual calzones.

recipes.title: Gnocchi al Sorrento
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food gnocchi al sorrento prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Make Potato Gnocchi: Mash 2 boiled potatoes with 1 cup flour; shape into bite-sized gnocchi dumplings.
Boil Gnocchi: Boil in water until dumplings float to the top (about 3 minutes).
Bake with Cheese: Toss with 1 cup tomato sauce, top with 200g mozzarella and basil; bake 10 minutes.
Portion 4 Dishes: Serve hot bubbly cheesy gnocchi into 4 pasta dishes.

recipes.title: Pasta Puttanesca
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food pasta puttanesca prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Boil Spaghetti: Cook 400g spaghetti pasta for 10 minutes.
Make Puttanesca Sauce: Sauté 1 head minced garlic and 4 chilies in 3 tbsp olive oil, add 1 cup tomato sauce; simmer 8 minutes.
Combine: Toss spaghetti in rich robust tomato sauce.
Portion 4 Bowls: Serve hot pasta into 4 bowls.

recipes.title: Chicken Piccata
recipes.description: Authentic Italian Food chicken piccata prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Dredge Chicken: Coat 1kg thin chicken cutlets in 1 cup flour.
Pan Sear: Pan fry cutlets in 50g butter for 3 minutes per side until golden.
Pan Sauce: Deglaze pan with 4 calamansi/lemon juices and 1 head garlic; simmer 3 minutes.
Portion 4 Servings: Plate chicken cutlets coated in tangy lemon butter sauce for 4 servings.

recipes.title: Pesto alla Genovese Pasta
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food pesto alla genovese pasta prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Blend Fresh Pesto: Blend 1 bunch basil, 1 head garlic, 100g parmesan, and 3 tbsp olive oil into smooth green pesto.
Boil Pasta: Cook 400g pasta for 10 minutes.
Toss Pesto: Fold freshly blended green pesto into hot pasta off the heat.
Portion 4 Plates: Divide aromatic pesto pasta across 4 dinner plates.

recipes.title: Porchetta Roast
recipes.description: Authentic Italian Food porchetta roast prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Season Pork Belly: Rub 1kg pork belly with 1 head minced garlic, 1 tbsp peppercorns, and sea salt.
Roll & Tie: Roll pork belly tight and tie firmly with butcher string.
Roast Crackling: Roast at 200°C (400°F) for 80 minutes until skin is super crispy crackling.
Portion 4 Servings: Slice into thick juicy pork rounds; serve 4 roasted porchetta portions.

recipes.title: Bruschetta al Pomodoro
recipes.description: Authentic Italian Food bruschetta al pomodoro prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Dice Tomato Mix: Dice 3 fresh tomatoes, mix with 1 bunch basil, 3 tbsp olive oil, and salt.
Toast Bread: Toast 4 crusty bread slices, rub with 1 head garlic clove.
Top Crusts: Spoon fresh tomato basil mixture generously over garlic toasts.
Portion 4 Toast Plates: Serve 1 large bruschetta toast per serving for 4 starters.

recipes.title: Polenta Con Ragù
recipes.description: Authentic Italian Food polenta con ragù prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Cook Creamy Polenta: Whisk cornmeal flour in 4 cups simmering water with 50g butter and parmesan for 20 minutes.
Cook Beef Ragù: Sauté 500g ground beef with 2 onions and 1 cup tomato sauce for 20 minutes.
Assemble: Spoon warm creamy polenta into bowls, top with rich beef ragù.
Portion 4 Dishes: Serve 4 hearty polenta bowls.

recipes.title: Rigatoni al Forno
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food rigatoni al forno prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Boil Rigatoni: Cook 400g rigatoni pasta for 9 minutes.
Sauté Sausage: Brown 4 Italian sausage links sliced into rounds with 1 cup tomato sauce.
Bake Cheesy Pasta: Toss rigatoni in sauce, top with 200g mozzarella and parmesan; bake 20 minutes.
Portion 4 Plates: Slice and serve 4 baked rigatoni portions.

recipes.title: Cannoli Siciliani
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food cannoli siciliani prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Fry Shells: Roll dough thin, wrap around metal tubes, and fry in oil for 3 minutes until crisp.
Whip Sweet Ricotta: Whip 250g ricotta with 3 tbsp sugar and 1/2 cup cream until smooth.
Pipe Cannoli: Pipe sweet ricotta filling into fried crispy cannoli shells.
Portion 4 Servings: Dust with powdered sugar; yield 4 dessert servings (2 cannoli per serving).

recipes.title: Zuppa di Pesce
recipes.description: Authentic Italian Food zuppa di pesce prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Sauté Garlic Base: Sauté 1 head garlic in 3 tbsp olive oil for 2 minutes.
Simmer Tomato Stock: Add 1 cup tomato sauce and 2 cups fish stock; simmer 10 minutes.
Poach Seafood: Add 500g shrimp, 500g clams, and 500g squid; simmer 8 minutes until clams open.
Portion 4 Bowls: Ladle rich Italian seafood stew into 4 bowls.

recipes.title: Arancini Rice Balls
recipes.description: Authentic Italian Food arancini rice balls prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Shape Risotto Balls: Roll chilled cooked risotto into 8 balls, stuffing a 200g mozzarella cube inside each.
Bread Balls: Dip balls into 2 beaten eggs and coat in 1 cup panko breadcrumbs.
Deep Fry: Fry in hot oil for 5 minutes until crispy golden brown.
Portion 4 Plates: Serve 2 cheesy arancini rice balls per plate for 4 servings.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food spaghetti aglio e olio prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Boil Pasta: Cook 400g spaghetti in salted water for 10 minutes.
Sauté Garlic Oil: Sauté 1 head thinly sliced garlic and 4 chilies in 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil until garlic is golden.
Toss Pasta: Toss spaghetti directly into garlic oil with 1/4 cup starchy pasta water.
Portion 4 Bowls: Garnish with parmesan cheese; divide across 4 pasta bowls.

recipes.title: Saltimbocca alla Romana
recipes.description: Authentic Italian Food saltimbocca alla romana prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Assemble Cutlets: Top 4 pork chops with 300g crispy bacon slice and sage leaf; pin with toothpick.
Pan Fry: Dredge lightly in 1 cup flour; pan fry in 50g butter for 3 minutes per side.
Glaze: Deglaze pan with 1/2 cup broth; reduce into pan glaze.
Portion 4 Plates: Serve 1 saltimbocca pork cutlet per plate across 4 servings.

recipes.title: Focaccia Bread with Rosemary
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food focaccia bread with rosemary prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Proof Focaccia: Mix 1 cup flour, yeast, and water; press dough into baking tray and dimple with fingers.
Drizzle Olive Oil: Drizzle 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 1 head minced garlic, and sea salt.
Bake Golden: Bake at 210°C (410°F) for 22 minutes until crusty and golden brown.
Slice 4 Portions: Cut warm focaccia bread into 4 large slab portions.

recipes.title: Affogato al Caffè
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food affogato al caffè prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Scoop Ice Cream: Place 1 scoop vanilla ice cream into 4 dessert glasses.
Brew Hot Espresso: Brew 4 fresh shots of hot espresso coffee.
Pour Hot Coffee: Pour 1 hot espresso shot over vanilla ice cream right before serving.
Portion 4 Glasses: Serve 4 hot-and-cold affogato dessert glasses.

recipes.title: Classic Cheeseburger
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food classic cheeseburger prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Form Patties: Divide 500g ground beef into 4 burger patties; season with salt and black pepper.
Grill Patties: Grill on high heat for 4 minutes per side; top each with 150g cheddar slice to melt.
Toast Buns: Toast 4 burger buns with butter until golden.
Assemble 4 Burgers: Layer toasted buns, beef patty with melted cheddar, sliced tomatoes, onions, ketchup, and mustard for 4 servings.

recipes.title: BBQ Pork Ribs
recipes.description: Authentic American Food bbq pork ribs prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Spice Rub: Season 1kg pork ribs with 3 tbsp brown sugar, 1 head garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Slow Bake: Wrap ribs tight in foil and bake at 150°C (300°F) for 75 minutes until tender.
Glaze BBQ: Unwrap, slather with 1 cup BBQ sauce, and broil high for 10 minutes until caramelized.
Portion 4 Servings: Slice rack of ribs into 4 individual serving portions.

recipes.title: Southern Fried Chicken
recipes.description: Authentic American Food southern fried chicken prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Marinate Chicken: Soak 1kg chicken pieces in seasoned milk for 15 minutes.
Double Dredge: Dip chicken in 2 beaten eggs, then coat thoroughly in 1 cup flour with spices.
Deep Fry: Deep fry in hot cooking oil at 175°C (350°F) for 15 minutes until crispy and golden brown.
Portion 4 Plates: Drain on paper towels; divide fried chicken across 4 dinner plates.

recipes.title: Macaroni & Cheese
recipes.description: Authentic American Food macaroni & cheese prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Boil Elbow Macaroni: Cook 400g macaroni pasta in salted water for 8 minutes.
Make Cheese Sauce: Melt 50g butter, whisk in 1 cup flour, pour 1 can evaporated milk, and stir in 150g cheddar until smooth.
Combine & Bake: Fold cooked macaroni into cheese sauce, top with extra cheddar, and bake 10 minutes.
Portion 4 Bowls: Serve rich creamy mac & cheese across 4 bowls.

recipes.title: New England Clam Chowder
recipes.description: Authentic American Food new england clam chowder prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Crisp Bacon: Fry 300g chopped bacon in pot until crispy; remove bacon.
Sauté & Simmer: Sauté 2 onions in bacon fat, add 2 diced potatoes, clam juice, and 2 cups water; simmer 15 minutes.
Add Clams & Cream: Stir in 500g chopped clams and 1 cup heavy cream; simmer 5 minutes.
Portion 4 Soup Bowls: Garnish with crispy bacon; ladle creamy clam chowder into 4 soup bowls.

recipes.title: Pulled Pork Sandwich
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food pulled pork sandwich prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Slow Roast Pork: Rub 800g pork shoulder with 3 tbsp brown sugar and spices; slow roast at 140°C (280°F) for 2 hours.
Shred Pork: Shred tender pork with two forks into juicy strands.
Toss BBQ Sauce: Toss shredded pork with 1 cup BBQ sauce and 0.5 cup cane vinegar.
Portion 4 Sandwiches: Pile pulled pork high onto 4 toasted burger buns.

recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Wings
recipes.description: Authentic American Food buffalo chicken wings prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Bake Wings: Toss 1kg chicken wingettes in 1 cup flour; bake at 200°C (400°F) for 25 minutes until extra crispy.
Make Buffalo Sauce: Melt 50g butter with 3 tbsp spicy chili hot sauce in a large bowl.
Toss Wings: Toss hot baked wings in buffalo sauce until fully coated.
Portion 4 Baskets: Serve spicy buffalo wings with celery sticks across 4 serving baskets.

recipes.title: American Apple Pie
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food american apple pie prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Prepare Filling: Toss 3 peeled sliced apples with 3 tbsp brown sugar and cinnamon.
Make Pie Crust: Roll 1 cup flour with 50g cold butter and water into 2 pie dough sheets.
Assemble & Bake: Fill bottom pie crust with apple filling, cover with lattice top crust; bake at 190°C (375°F) for 45 minutes.
Slice 4 Portions: Let pie cool for 20 minutes; cut into 4 large slices.

recipes.title: New York Cheesecake
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food new york cheesecake prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Crust Base: Press crushed graham biscuit crumbs with 50g melted butter into pie pan base.
Whip Filling: Beat cream cheese with 1 cup heavy cream, 3 tbsp sugar, and 2 eggs until smooth.
Bake Cheesecake: Bake at 160°C (325°F) for 55 minutes until center is just set.
Portion 4 Slices: Chill in refrigerator 4 hours; slice into 4 rich cheesecake portions.

recipes.title: Pancakes & Bacon Stack
recipes.description: Authentic American Food pancakes & bacon stack prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Mix Batter: Whisk 1 cup flour, 2 eggs, 1 cup milk, and melted butter into smooth batter.
Cook Pancakes: Pour batter onto hot griddle, cook 2 minutes per side until golden brown (makes 8 pancakes).
Crisp Bacon: Fry 300g bacon strip slices for 6 minutes until crispy.
Portion 4 Stacks: Stack 2 fluffy pancakes per plate, top with 2 bacon strips and natural honey for 4 breakfast servings.

recipes.title: Philly Cheesesteak Sandwich
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food philly cheesesteak sandwich prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Sear Thin Beef Steak: Thinly slice 2 ribeye steaks; sear over high heat with 50g butter for 5 minutes.
Sauté Veggies: Sauté 2 onions and 1 sliced bell pepper until caramelized.
Melt Cheese: Combine beef and veggies, top with 150g provolone slices to melt.
Portion 4 Rolls: Stuff cheesy beef steak into 4 toasted hoagie rolls.

recipes.title: Texas Chili Con Carne
recipes.description: Authentic American Food texas chili con carne prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Brown Ground Beef: Sauté 500g ground beef with 2 onions and 1 head garlic for 8 minutes.
Simmer Chili: Add 1 can diced tomatoes, 4 chopped chilies, cumin, and 2 cups water; simmer low for 35 minutes.
Thicken Stock: Reduce chili until thick and fragrant.
Portion 4 Bowls: Ladle spicy chili into 4 bowls; top with 150g shredded cheddar cheese.

recipes.title: Grilled Cheese & Tomato Soup
recipes.description: Authentic American Food grilled cheese & tomato soup prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Make Tomato Soup: Simmer 1 cup tomato sauce with 1 cup heavy cream and butter for 10 minutes.
Assemble Grilled Cheese: Butter 8 bread slices, fill with 150g cheddar cheese.
Grill Sandwiches: Grill sandwiches in pan for 3 minutes per side until bread is golden and cheese melts.
Portion 4 Combos: Serve 1 grilled cheese sandwich with 1 cup tomato soup for 4 lunch combos.

recipes.title: Chicken Tendy Basket with Fries
recipes.description: Authentic American Food chicken tendy basket with fries prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Bread Tenderloins: Slice 1kg chicken breasts into strips; dip in 2 eggs and coat in 1 cup panko breadcrumbs.
Fry Tenders & Fries: Fry tenders and 2 sliced potatoes in oil for 6 minutes until crispy.
Make Honey Mustard: Mix 2 tbsp honey with 2 tbsp yellow mustard.
Portion 4 Baskets: Serve chicken tenders and fries with honey mustard across 4 baskets.

recipes.title: Cobb Salad
recipes.description: Authentic American Food cobb salad prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Cook Proteins: Grill 1kg chicken breast and fry 300g bacon strips; boil 2 eggs.
Dice Ingredients: Slice chicken, bacon, eggs, 2 avocados, and 3 tomatoes.
Arrange Salad: Arrange salad ingredients in neat rows over lettuce bed.
Portion 4 Plates: Divide fresh Cobb salad across 4 dinner plates.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes Sandwich
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food sloppy joes sandwich prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Brown Ground Beef: Brown 500g ground beef with 2 onions and 1 bell pepper for 7 minutes.
Simmer Sweet Sauce: Add 3 tbsp ketchup, 2 tbsp mustard, and 2 tbsp brown sugar; simmer 8 minutes until thick.
Stuff Buns: Spoon savory meat sauce generously into toasted buns.
Portion 4 Sandwiches: Serve 4 messy, delicious Sloppy Joe sandwiches.

recipes.title: Meatloaf with Gravy
recipes.description: Authentic American Food meatloaf with gravy prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Mix Meatloaf: Combine 500g ground beef, 1 cup breadcrumbs, 2 eggs, and 2 chopped onions.
Shape & Glaze: Pack into loaf pan, glaze top with 3 tbsp ketchup and brown sugar.
Bake Loaf: Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 45 minutes until cooked through.
Portion 4 Slices: Let rest 10 minutes, slice into 4 thick meatloaf portions.

recipes.title: Jambalaya Cajun Rice
recipes.description: Authentic American Food jambalaya cajun rice prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Sear Proteins: Brown 1kg chicken, 4 sausage links, and 500g shrimp in oil for 6 minutes.
Sauté Trinity: Add 2 onions, 1 bell pepper, 1 can diced tomatoes, and 3 cups rice.
Simmer Cajun Rice: Pour 4 cups chicken stock; cover and simmer low for 20 minutes.
Portion 4 Bowls: Serve spicy Cajun Jambalaya rice across 4 bowls.

recipes.title: Corn Chowder
recipes.description: Authentic American Food corn chowder prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Crisp Bacon: Fry 300g bacon strips; remove and chop.
Sauté & Cook Corn: Sauté 2 diced potatoes and sweet corn kernels off 2 cobs in 50g butter.
Simmer Cream Stock: Add 3 cups broth and 1 cup heavy cream; simmer 18 minutes until potatoes are soft.
Portion 4 Bowls: Ladle rich sweet corn chowder into 4 soup bowls.

recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Pizza
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food buffalo chicken pizza prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Prep Pizza Base: Stretch dough onto pizza tray.
Top Buffalo Chicken: Toss cooked chicken in melted butter and spicy sauce; spread over base with 200g mozzarella.
Bake Hot: Bake at 230°C (450°F) for 14 minutes until crust is crispy and cheese melted.
Portion 4 Pies: Slice pizza into 4 personal pie portions.

recipes.title: Reuben Sandwich
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food reuben sandwich prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Layer Sandwich: Layer sliced beef brisket, sauerkraut, and cheese between rye bread slices.
Butter Toast: Butter outside of bread slices.
Pan Grill: Grill in skillet for 4 minutes per side until bread is golden and cheese is melted.
Portion 4 Sandwiches: Cut sandwiches in half; serve 4 Reuben lunches.

recipes.title: Pork Chops with Apple Sauce
recipes.description: Authentic American Food pork chops with apple sauce prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Make Apple Sauce: Simmer 3 peeled apples with 3 tbsp brown sugar and 50g butter for 12 minutes until soft; mash.
Sear Pork Chops: Season 4 pork chops; sear in pan for 5 minutes per side until juicy.
Combine: Plate pork chops and spoon warm apple sauce over top.
Portion 4 Plates: Serve 1 pork chop with apple sauce per plate across 4 servings.

recipes.title: BLT Sandwich
recipes.description: Authentic American Food blt sandwich prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Crisp Bacon: Fry 300g bacon strips for 6 minutes until extra crispy.
Toast Bread: Toast 8 slices of sandwich bread; spread with 3 tbsp mayonnaise.
Assemble BLT: Layer crispy bacon, sliced fresh tomatoes, and lettuce leaves.
Portion 4 Sandwiches: Slice diagonally; serve 4 classic BLT sandwiches.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
recipes.description: Authentic American Food chicken pot pie prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Cook Filling: Sauté 1kg diced chicken, 2 carrots, and 2 potatoes in 50g butter, add 1 cup flour and 1 cup cream; simmer 10 minutes.
Fill Pie Dish: Pour thick chicken vegetable filling into baking dish.
Top Crust & Bake: Cover with pie dough sheet, cut vent slits, and bake at 200°C (400°F) for 25 minutes until golden brown.
Portion 4 Servings: Scoop warm bubbly chicken pot pie into 4 bowls.

recipes.title: Shrimp & Grits
recipes.description: Authentic American Food shrimp & grits prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Cook Creamy Grits: Boil cornmeal in 3 cups water with 50g butter, 1 cup cream, and 150g cheddar for 15 minutes.
Sauté Bacon Shrimp: Fry 300g chopped bacon, sauté 500g shrimp and 1 head garlic for 5 minutes.
Assemble: Spoon cheesy grits into bowls, top with garlic bacon shrimp.
Portion 4 Bowls: Serve 4 Southern shrimp & grits portions.

recipes.title: Tater Tots Casserole
recipes.description: Authentic American Food tater tots casserole prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Brown Meat: Sauté 500g ground beef with 2 onions for 7 minutes; spread in baking dish.
Top Tater Tots: Arrange potato tater tots in a layer over meat, top with 150g cheddar cheese.
Bake Crispy: Bake at 190°C (375°F) for 22 minutes until tater tots are crispy golden.
Portion 4 Servings: Cut and serve 4 casserole portions.

recipes.title: Key Lime Pie
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food key lime pie prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Make Crust: Press graham crumbs with 50g melted butter into pie tin.
Whip Custard: Whisk 1 can condensed milk, 4 egg yolks, and 1/2 cup fresh lime/calamansi juice until thick.
Bake & Chill: Bake at 175°C (350°F) for 15 minutes; chill 3 hours.
Slice 4 Slices: Slice tangy lime pie into 4 dessert portions.

recipes.title: Fudge Brownies
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food fudge brownies prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Melt Chocolate & Butter: Melt 50g butter with cocoa powder and 3 tbsp brown sugar.
Mix Batter: Whisk in 2 eggs and 1 cup flour until shiny chocolate batter forms.
Bake Fudgy: Bake in square pan at 175°C (350°F) for 22 minutes.
Cut 4 Portions: Cut into 4 large fudgy brownie squares.

recipes.title: Cornbread Slabs
recipes.description: Authentic American Food cornbread slabs prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Mix Cornbread Batter: Combine cornmeal, 1 cup flour, 2 eggs, 50g melted butter, and 2 tbsp honey.
Bake Pan: Pour batter into greased skillet or pan.
Bake Golden: Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 20 minutes until golden brown top.
Slice 4 Slabs: Slice warm cornbread into 4 large slabs.

recipes.title: Banana Split Sundae
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food banana split sundae prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Split Banana: Slice 4 bananas lengthwise into long halves.
Scoop Ice Cream: Place banana split halves in 4 long dessert dishes with ice cream scoops.
Top Whipped Cream: Drizzle chocolate sauce, top with whipped cream and cherries.
Portion 4 Bowls: Serve 4 classic banana split sundaes.

recipes.title: Japanese Miso & Salmon Breakfast
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food japanese miso & salmon breakfast prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Grill Salmon: Season 2 salmon fillets with salt; grill for 4 minutes per side until skin is crispy.
Prepare Miso Soup: Warm 3 cups dashi stock, dissolve 2 tbsp miso paste, add 300g diced tofu.
Steam Japanese Rice: Cook 3 cups Japanese short-grain white rice until fluffy.
Assemble 4 Trays: Serve grilled salmon, miso soup bowl, rice, and nori sheets across 4 traditional breakfast trays.

recipes.title: Chicken Katsu Curry
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food chicken katsu curry prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Cook Curry Sauce: Sauté 2 onions, 2 carrots, and 2 potatoes; add 3 cups water and 1 box curry roux, simmer 15 minutes.
Bread Cutlets: Coat 1kg chicken breasts in flour, 2 beaten eggs, and 1 cup panko breadcrumbs.
Fry Golden: Deep fry chicken cutlets for 6 minutes until golden brown; slice into strips.
Portion 4 Plates: Ladle rich Japanese curry over rice, top with sliced chicken katsu for 4 servings.

recipes.title: Pork Katsudon
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food pork katsudon prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Fry Tonkatsu: Bread 800g pork chops in panko and fry 6 minutes until golden.
Simmer Dashi Glaze: Simmer 2 sliced onions with 0.5 cup soy sauce, mirin, and dashi in skillet.
Poach Eggs over Cutlet: Place sliced tonkatsu into simmering sauce, pour 2 beaten eggs over top; cover 1 minute until soft set.
Portion 4 Donburi Bowls: Slide cooked katsudon over 4 bowls of warm steamed rice.

recipes.title: Beef Gyudon
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food beef gyudon prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Simmer Sweet Onion: Simmer 2 thinly sliced onions in 0.5 cup soy sauce, mirin, and dashi for 5 minutes.
Cook Thin Beef: Add 500g thinly sliced beef brisket; simmer 5 minutes until tender.
Steam Rice: Prepare 4 bowls of hot white rice.
Portion 4 Gyudon Bowls: Top rice with sweet savory beef and onions; garnish each with poached egg.

recipes.title: Shrimp Tempura Bowl (Tendon)
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food shrimp tempura bowl (tendon) prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Make Batter: Whisk 1 cup flour with ice-cold water and 1 egg yolk into light tempura batter.
Fry Tempura: Dip 500g stretched shrimp into batter; deep fry in hot oil for 3 minutes until crispy lace.
Make Drizzle Glaze: Simmer 0.5 cup soy sauce and mirin for 3 minutes until syrupy.
Portion 4 Bowls: Arrange crispy shrimp tempura over 4 bowls of rice and drizzle with sweet glaze.

recipes.title: Okonomiyaki Savory Pancake
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food okonomiyaki savory pancake prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Mix Cabbage Batter: Mix 1 cup flour, 2 eggs, 1 cup dashi, and 2 cups shredded cabbage.
Grill Pancake: Pour batter onto griddle, lay 300g bacon strips on top, cook 6 minutes per side.
Drizzle Sauces: Brush savory brown sauce and criss-cross Japanese mayo over pancake.
Slice 4 Portions: Cut into 4 large okonomiyaki slices.

recipes.title: Tonkotsu Ramen
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food tonkotsu ramen prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Prepare Rich Broth: Simmer rich pork bone broth with 1 head garlic and soy sauce for 30 minutes.
Boil Ramen: Cook 2 packs ramen noodles for 3 minutes; drain.
Braised Chashu: Sear 1kg pork belly slice rounds until golden.
Portion 4 Bowls: Divide noodles into 4 deep bowls, pour steaming tonkotsu broth, top with chashu pork, ramen egg, and nori.

recipes.title: Chicken Teriyaki Bowl
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food chicken teriyaki bowl prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Make Teriyaki Glaze: Simmer 0.5 cup soy sauce, mirin, and 3 tbsp brown sugar for 5 minutes until thick glaze.
Pan Sear Chicken: Sear 1kg chicken thighs in pan for 6 minutes per side.
Glaze & Slice: Brush teriyaki glaze over chicken; slice into bite-sized strips.
Portion 4 Bowls: Serve teriyaki chicken over steamed rice in 4 bowls; sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Tamagoyaki Breakfast Set
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food tamagoyaki breakfast set prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Whisk Egg Mixture: Whisk 4 eggs with 2 tbsp dashi, 2 tbsp mirin, and dash of soy sauce.
Roll Omelet: Pour thin layer into rectangular pan, roll, and repeat to form layered egg roll block.
Slice Tamagoyaki: Slice golden egg block into 8 neat rectangular slices.
Portion 4 Servings: Serve 2 Tamagoyaki slices with warm rice across 4 breakfast plates.

recipes.title: Japanese Matcha Sticky Rice Dessert
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food japanese matcha sticky rice dessert prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Cook Glutinous Rice: Steamed 2 cups sticky rice with 2 cups coconut milk for 18 minutes.
Infuse Matcha: Whisk 2 tbsp matcha green tea powder into 1 can condensed milk.
Fold & Chill: Mold warm sticky rice into sweet matcha balls, drizzle with green tea glaze.
Portion 4 Dessert Plates: Serve sweet matcha sticky rice across 4 dessert plates.

recipes.title: Yakitori Skewers
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food yakitori skewers prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Thread Skewers: Thread 1kg cubed chicken thighs and 2 onions onto bamboo skewers.
Make Tare Sauce: Simmer 0.5 cup soy sauce, mirin, and 3 tbsp brown sugar until glossy.
Grill & Baste: Grill skewers over high flame for 10 minutes, basting with sauce every 2 minutes.
Portion 4 Plattes: Serve 3 yakitori skewers per plate across 4 servings.

recipes.title: Miso Soup with Tofu & Wakame
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food miso soup with tofu & wakame prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Boil Dashi Broth: Heat 4 cups dashi stock in pot until warm.
Dissolve Miso: Remove from heat; whisk 2 tbsp miso paste through strainer into broth.
Add Tofu: Add 300g cubed tofu and green onions; gently warm 2 minutes.
Portion 4 Bowls: Ladle classic miso soup into 4 lacquer soup bowls.

recipes.title: Zaru Soba Cold Noodles
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food zaru soba cold noodles prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Boil Buckwheat Soba: Cook 250g buckwheat soba noodles for 5 minutes; drain and shock in ice water.
Make Tsuyu Dipping Sauce: Mix 1 cup chilled dashi, 0.5 cup soy sauce, and mirin.
Arrange Bamboo Mat: Place cold soba on bamboo mats, top with shredded nori.
Portion 4 Trays: Serve cold soba noodles with dipping sauce cups for 4 summer lunches.

recipes.title: Beef Sukiyaki Hotpot
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food beef sukiyaki hotpot prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Simmer Sukiyaki Broth: Simmer 0.5 cup soy sauce, mirin, and 2 tbsp sugar in hotpot dish.
Cook Beef & Veggies: Arrange 500g thin beef slice, 300g tofu, 200g mushrooms, and 300g udon noodles in pot.
Simmer Tabletop: Simmer for 12 minutes until beef is tender.
Portion 4 Bowls: Dip tender beef and noodles in raw beaten egg; ladle into 4 bowls.

recipes.title: Unagi Don (Grilled Eel Bowl)
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food unagi don (grilled eel bowl) prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Glaze Fish Fillets: Brush 2 large fish fillets with soy sauce, mirin, and sugar glaze.
Broil Fish: Broil under oven flame for 10 minutes until caramelized and smoky.
Steam Rice: Fluff 4 bowls of warm Japanese white rice.
Portion 4 Bowls: Top rice with sweet unagi-style glazed fish fillets and nori strips.

recipes.title: Chawanmushi Egg Custard
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food chawanmushi egg custard prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Whisk Egg Custard: Gently whisk 4 eggs with 2 cups dashi and 1 tbsp soy sauce; strain to remove bubbles.
Fill Cups: Place 500g shrimp and 200g sliced mushrooms into 4 teacups.
Steam Gently: Pour egg mixture into cups; steam on low heat for 12 minutes until silky smooth.
Portion 4 Cups: Serve 4 warm savoury egg custard cups.

recipes.title: Pork Shogayaki (Ginger Pork)
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food pork shogayaki (ginger pork) prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Grate Ginger Sauce: Mix 1 thumb grated ginger with 0.5 cup soy sauce and mirin.
Pan Sear Pork: Sauté 800g thin pork shoulder slices and 2 onions in oil for 6 minutes.
Glaze Pork: Pour ginger sauce into skillet; toss 2 minutes until glossy and fragrant.
Portion 4 Plates: Serve ginger pork with shredded cabbage and rice for 4 servings.

recipes.title: Japanese Potato Salad
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food japanese potato salad prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Boil Potatoes: Boil 2 potatoes until tender; rough mash leaving chunky pieces.
Hard Boil Egg: Boil 2 eggs, dice into small pieces.
Mix Japanese Mayo: Fold potatoes, eggs, 2 diced carrots, and 3 tbsp Japanese mayonnaise together.
Portion 4 Bowls: Chill 30 minutes; divide creamy potato salad into 4 side bowls.

recipes.title: Karaage Fried Chicken
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food karaage fried chicken prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Marinate Chicken: Marinate 1kg cubed chicken thighs in 0.5 cup soy sauce, 1 thumb grated ginger, and garlic for 15 minutes.
Coat Flour: Dredge chicken pieces thoroughly in potato starch / flour.
Double Fry: Fry in hot oil for 4 minutes, rest 2 minutes, then fry 2 minutes more until super crispy.
Portion 4 Plates: Serve golden crispy karaage with lemon wedges across 4 plates.

recipes.title: Niku Jaga (Beef & Potato Stew)
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food niku jaga (beef & potato stew) prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Sauté Beef & Veggies: Sauté 500g thin beef, 2 diced potatoes, 2 carrots, and 2 onions for 5 minutes.
Simmer Soy Stock: Pour 2 cups dashi, 0.5 cup soy sauce, mirin, and 2 tbsp sugar.
Simmer Sweet Stew: Cover and simmer low for 20 minutes until potatoes are fork tender.
Portion 4 Bowls: Serve sweet Japanese beef & potato stew across 4 deep bowls.

recipes.title: Yaki Udon Stir Fry Noodles
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food yaki udon stir fry noodles prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Sauté Pork & Veggies: Sauté 1kg sliced pork belly, 2 carrots, and 200g mushrooms in skillet for 6 minutes.
Add Udon Noodles: Add 300g thick udon noodles and 0.5 cup soy sauce glaze.
Stir Fry High Heat: Toss stir fry on high heat for 4 minutes until noodles absorb sauce.
Portion 4 Plates: Divide savory Yaki Udon noodles across 4 plates.

recipes.title: Miso Glazed Eggplant (Nasu Dengaku)
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food miso glazed eggplant (nasu dengaku) prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Score Eggplant: Slice 2 eggplants in half lengthwise; score crosshatch pattern into flesh.
Pan Broil: Fry eggplants cut-side down in oil for 6 minutes until soft.
Glaze Sweet Miso: Spread 2 tbsp miso paste, mirin, and sugar glaze over top; broil 4 minutes until caramelized.
Portion 4 Plates: Garnish with sesame seeds; serve 1 glazed eggplant half per plate across 4 servings.

recipes.title: Matcha Ice Cream Float
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food matcha ice cream float prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Whisk Matcha Tea: Whisk 2 tbsp matcha powder with 1 cup warm water until frothy.
Fill Glasses with Ice: Fill 4 tall dessert glasses with ice cubes.
Pour Green Tea: Pour frothy green tea over ice in glasses.
Top Ice Cream: Top each with 1 scoop vanilla ice cream for 4 refreshing matcha floats.

recipes.title: Omurice (Japanese Omelette Rice)
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food omurice (japanese omelette rice) prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Cook Ketchup Rice: Sauté 1kg diced chicken and 3 cups cooked rice with 3 tbsp ketchup for 6 minutes.
Form Rice Mound: Mold ketchup chicken rice into oval mounds on 4 plates.
Cook Soft Omelet: Whisk 4 eggs, melt 50g butter in pan, cook soft tornado omelet.
Portion 4 Plates: Drape silky soft omelet over ketchup rice; drizzle ketchup on top for 4 servings.

recipes.title: Dorayaki Sweet Red Bean Pancakes
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food dorayaki sweet red bean pancakes prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Make Honey Pancake Batter: Whisk 1 cup flour, 2 eggs, 2 tbsp honey, and sugar into smooth batter.
Cook Mini Pancakes: Cook small round pancakes on griddle for 2 minutes per side (makes 8 mini pancakes).
Stuff Sweet Bean: Sandwich 2 tbsp sweet red bean paste between two honey pancakes.
Portion 4 Servings: Serve 1 stuffed dorayaki pancake sandwich per serving for 4 dessert portions.

recipes.title: Hiyashi Chuka Cold Ramen
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food hiyashi chuka cold ramen prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Boil Cold Ramen: Cook 2 packs ramen noodles; drain and chill in ice water.
Slice Toppings: Shred thin egg omelet, 300g cooked bacon, and cucumber strips.
Make Sesame Dressing: Mix 0.5 cup soy sauce, 0.5 cup cane vinegar, 2 tbsp sesame oil, and sugar.
Portion 4 Bowls: Arrange toppings neatly over cold noodles in 4 bowls; pour tangy sesame dressing.

recipes.title: Japanese Beef Curry
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food japanese beef curry prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Sauté Beef & Veggies: Sauté 500g ground beef, 2 onions, 2 carrots, and 2 potatoes for 8 minutes.
Simmer Curry Roux: Add 3 cups water; simmer 15 minutes, then melt 1 box Japanese curry roux into pot.
Simmer Thick: Simmer low for 10 minutes until thick and glossy.
Portion 4 Plates: Serve rich Japanese beef curry over steamed rice across 4 plates.

recipes.title: Gyoza Dumplings
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food gyoza dumplings prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Mix Gyoza Filling: Combine 500g ground meat, 1 head garlic, 1 thumb ginger, 2 tbsp soy sauce, and 2 tbsp sesame oil.
Wrap Dumplings: Pleat 1 tbsp filling inside 20 gyoza wrapper skins.
Pan Fry & Steam: Fry dumplings in oil for 3 minutes until bottom is golden, add 1/4 cup water, cover and steam 4 minutes.
Portion 4 Plates: Serve 5 crispy pan-fried gyoza dumplings per plate with soy dipping sauce across 4 servings.

recipes.title: Soufflé Pancakes
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food soufflé pancakes prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Whip Stiff Meringue: Separate 4 eggs; whip egg whites with 3 tbsp sugar into stiff glossy meringue peaks.
Fold Batter: Fold yolk flour mixture gently into meringue.
Steam Cook Low: Scoop tall batter mounds onto griddle, add 1 tbsp water, cover and cook low for 7 minutes per side.
Portion 4 Plates: Serve tall fluffy soufflé pancakes with butter and honey for 4 breakfast servings.

recipes.title: Ebi Fry (Breaded Fried Shrimp)
recipes.description: Authentic Filipino Food ebi fry (breaded fried shrimp) prepared traditional style with rich savory flavors.
steps: Stretch Shrimp: Straighten 500g jumbo shrimp by scoring underside.
Bread Shrimp: Dredge in 1 cup flour, 2 beaten eggs, and 1 cup panko breadcrumbs.
Deep Fry: Deep fry in hot oil for 3 minutes until golden crispy.
Portion 4 Plates: Serve 3 crispy ebi fry shrimp per plate with tartar mayonnaise for 4 dinner portions.
